catalysts.headline: Q3 2026 earnings were due after market close today per multiple converging aggregators already on file. The actual reported figures could not be independently confirmed this session: WebFetch failed to resolve every news/IR domain tried (ir.akamai.com, sec.gov, rttnews.com, rallies.ai, stocktitan.net, nasdaq.com) and this batch's shared WebSearch budget was exhausted before a clean confirmation could be obtained. Two unverified search-result headlines surfaced -- an RTTNews title stating Akamai 'Q3 profit increases, beats estimates,' and a rallies.ai title citing 'Q3 Cloud Services Up 39% with Expanded Deutsche Telekom Security Partnership' -- but neither article's body was retrievable, and the search tool's own summary flagged the RTTNews EPS/revenue figures it extracted ($0.97 EPS, $1.054B revenue) as more likely matching Q3 2025 than Q3 2026, so they are NOT recorded as this quarter's print.

catalysts.headline: Announced expanded 7-year, $11.6B cloud services deal with Anthropic (option to scale to ~$20B total) to support Anthropic's CPU compute workloads on Akamai Cloud; issued Anthropic a warrant for up to ~5% of Akamai shares at a $111.33/share strike; also disclosed a ~$1.7B hardware supply arrangement with Lenovo and contract manufacturer Jabil for memory components. Deal is >6x the size of a ~$1.8B Akamai-Anthropic deal reported in May 2026 and is described as the largest in Akamai's history.
